rows.vgi.doc_md:
## `cvss_severity_bands`

A browsable reference table of the five **CVSS v3.1 qualitative severity bands** and the inclusive base-score range each covers — the discovery counterpart to the `cvss_severity` scalar. It is fully offline and deterministic.

| severity | min_score | max_score |
|---|---|---|
| NONE | 0.0 | 0.0 |
| LOW | 0.1 | 3.9 |
| MEDIUM | 4.0 | 6.9 |
| HIGH | 7.0 | 8.9 |
| CRITICAL | 9.0 | 10.0 |

Join it against a column of scores, or read it to learn the banding before calling `cvss_severity`.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description":"List the high-and-above CVSS severity bands with their score ranges.","sql":"SELECT severity, min_score, max_score FROM cve.main.cvss_severity_bands WHERE min_score >= 7.0 ORDER BY min_score;"},{"description":"Band a numeric CVSS score by joining it against the reference ranges.","sql":"SELECT b.severity FROM cve.main.cvss_severity_bands b WHERE 7.5 BETWEEN b.min_score AND b.max_score;"}]
